summary: Psychonauts entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Psychonauts
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with compatibility and controller state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; console emulation only for platform comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC release or original Xbox/PS2 hardware for console comparison

primary.why: Psychonauts' current PC release is the best capture/settings route for the original game, while Xbox and PS2 are historical console routes. Compatibility, controller, and widescreen state should be logged for a clean archive run.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, compatibility fixes, controller, resolution/widescreen state, collectibles/rank, difficulty assists if any, and whether console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console control/performance.
secondary.why: PC is the strongest capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront/build, controller, widescreen/resolution, and collectible/rank completion.
